subject: Exec alignment + technical deep-dive — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aishasolutions.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@aishasolutions.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, May 7, 2027 at 2:12 PM PDT
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (tech deep-dive / exec intro)

Thanks again for the time today, Oliver and Sana — really useful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary:
- Primary use case: customer support triage + agent assist across ~30k monthly conversations, multi-region (US + EU).
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p50 response time for agent-facing flows, strict data residency for EU customers, and predictable monthly spend.

Open questions we committed to follow up on:
- Expected peak concurrent requests and typical sequence lengths (we'll use this for capacity estimate) — Oliver to confirm.
- Any legal/security docs we should prep ahead of an exec call (SOC2 scope, data retention requirements) — Sana to confirm.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive + demo (deep into batching/latency, KV cache, and routing) — target 60–75 minutes; audience: engineering + platform.
2) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to unblock procurement & timeline — 30 minutes.

Availability (our side):
- Wed, May 12: 9:00–11:30 PT or 1:00–4:00 PT
- Thu, May 13: 11:00–3:30 PT

If you can share times that work for your engineering team and (if possible) include your CTO for the exec intro we can slot both meetings back-to-back if that helps.

Attaching the discovery notes and an initial capacity estimate so you have something to review ahead of the deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0178

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, capacity-estimate.xlsx

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aishasolutions.com>

Date: Fri, May 7, 2027 at 4:05 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (tech deep-dive / exec intro)

Thanks Marissa — great recap and thanks to the team for the clear notes. A couple quick answers: 

- Peak concurrency: we typically see ~120 concurrent agent sessions during support peaks, with ~250–300 token exchanges per session on average. I'll push a small export to you for exact histograms by EOD.
- Legal/Security: Sana will share the SOC2 and a short list of compliance questions.

We'd like to include our CTO, Priya Sharma (priya.sharma@aishasolutions.com), for the executive intro. Proposed windows that work for our team:
- Wed, May 12: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, May 13: 2:00–3:00 PT

If you can accommodate Thu 2–3 PT that would be ideal (gives our CTO a clean slot). Also can you include a brief agenda for the exec call (goals: timeline, procurement milestones, primary risks)?

Oliver
